column3: CI runs web's prebuild tests (bun test src) and vite build as two parallel jobs instead of bun run build
column4: bun run build runs the tests and then the build in series. Splitting them takes the tests off the build's critical path, and both still run on every SHA
column5: web-test 3.3 s and web-build 13.6 s, run side by side on the PR 123 head
